async/barrier#

Cyclic cooperative rendezvous for a fixed number of parties.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let phase is Barrier = Barrier(parties: 4);

async worker() {
    prepare_partition();
    let arrival = await phase.wait();
    if arrival == 3 {
        publish_phase_metrics();
    }
    consume_prepared_partitions();
}

Description#

Cyclic cooperative rendezvous for a fixed number of parties.

Synopsis.

wait() suspends until exactly parties calls have arrived in the current generation. Arrivals receive distinct indexes 0..parties-1 in arrival order; the final arrival receives parties-1. Releasing one complete generation automatically begins the next generation.

state() returns an immutable observation. Its waiter count belongs to the current generation and may change immediately after observation.

Cancelling one pending wait breaks its complete generation. abort() does the same explicitly. Existing and future waits then throw BrokenBarrier until reset() is called. The cancelled wait itself remains Cancelled; the other waiters observe BrokenBarrier.

reset() first wakes every old waiter with BrokenBarrier, then advances to a fresh unbroken generation. It never moves an old waiter into the new one.
